mentions.name: Din
mentions.description: A personal finance manager where users log income and expenses and see everything in simple charts, making it easier to understand where the money goes and follow each month more clearly. Built with React + Vite on the frontend and Firebase on the backend.
mentions.problem: Understanding where the money goes and following each month clearly is difficult.
mentions.audience: Explicitly a personal finance manager for individuals tracking their own income and spending.
